Congratulations on qualifying for Specialty Benefits!
Click here to view this email as a web page.
Hello [FirstName],
Welcome to Intel® Technology Provider HPC Data Center Specialty Benefits! As a HPC Data Center Specialist you can take advantage of Specialty Benefits specifically designed to help you create winning HPC solutions and give you a competitive edge in the marketplace when deploying Intel®-based solutions.
As a qualified HPC Data Center Specialist, you are eligible for Specialty Benefits* that are designed to help you grow your HPC business including:
HPC Data Center Specialist designation Intel Promotion of your Company as an HPC Specialist Pre-sales technical support Special access to HPC resources HPC co-marketing opportunities Additional points offers for HPC Data Center Specialists Enhanced benefits for Intel® Server Products for HPC Compute Blocks Priority invitations to industry events and training sessions Opportunities for early product samples Access to remote benchmarking lab
Thank you again for being an active Intel Technology Provider.
Access Benefits >
*Benefits may vary by geography.
